basis: The pinned debug image built successfully.
The unchanged original v5 UE attached under a fresh static TDL-B realization.
The debug UE attached and emitted both radio and channel telemetry.
The smoke telemetry identified a static multipath TDL-B channel and the explicit RNG seed.
The original UE image was restored and reattached with no gNB restart.
The Phase 3C13 rollback target was corrected to the profile's v5 UE image and all profile tests passed.
stopping_rules: Stop on attachment loss, any critical failure marker, an unintended UE restart, or any gNB restart.
Stop if the active channel is not TDL_B or does not expose multipath dimensions.
Stop if a seed is missing, a tap fingerprint changes within an execution, or fingerprints are not distinct across executions.
Always restore the original v5 UE image and verify attachment.
known_risk: The initially provisioned uninstrumented TDL-B realization did not synchronize, while a recreated realization attached. The pilot therefore treats attachment as a per-seed operational outcome and fails closed.
still_prohibited: UPV distribution-support claims from this pilot alone
